newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss brewer Feldschloesschen has 95/96 loss, cuts dividend.
newsitem.headline: Swiss brewer Feldschloesschen has 95/96 loss, cuts dividend.

text.p: Swiss brewer Feldschloesschen-Huerlimann Holding AG said it had posted a 113 million Swiss franc ($77.3 million) loss after restructuring charges in the 1995/1996 business year ended September 30 and would cut its dividend to 15 percent of shares' nominal value from 22 percent.
The group, created by the merger of Feldschloesschen and Huerlimann breweries as of January 1 1996, had consolidated sales of nearly 1.2 billion Swiss francs, it said in a statement.
It said the merger made comparisons with the 1994/1995 business year difficult.
It gave group operating profit as 51 million francs. Consolidated cash flow was 152 million, down around 30 percent on a comparative basis.
Total restructuring costs of 315 milliion francs expected until the end of 1998 were booked against the 1995/96 results.
"Thus the Feldschloesschen group posted a one-off, expected loss of 113 million francs in the 1995/1996 brewing year," it said.
It said mangement would propose cutting the dividend to 15 percent from 22 percent.
It said it would present pro forma comparative figures at a news conference in Zurich on March 25.
